[Story]
Zhang Li buys a new book at the bookstore. When she gets home, she casually puts the book on the sofa and goes to cook dinner.  In the evening, Grandpa asks, "Where do you put your new book?" Zhang Li replies, "I put it on the bookshelf."

[Question]
Why does Zhang Li say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Zhang Li remembers she puts the book on the bookshelf.
B. Zhang Li really puts the book back on the bookshelf.
C. Zhang Li lies on purpose because she does not want her grandfather to know she puts things randomly.
D. Zhang Li is busy cooking and forgets where she puts the book.
